changelog.note: the model administration moved out of jav/config.py's constants: ids, prices, timeout, cache version
JEV framework round 1: cache_version 2 (the concrete model version in the cache key, a one-off invalidation), alias_ttl_hours, an explicit retry (the fields of typesafe_sdk.RetryPolicy)
Type packs: a Burr tracker project for the invoice_foreign pack (jav_invoice_foreign) and a default (invoice -> jav_invoice) for the other packs
Repeated security audit: openai.sdk_max_retries = 0 - the OpenAI client's own transport retries were paid requests outside the reservation; the work queue repeats a failed item instead
Repeated security audit; Azure recipe switch: azure_di.usd_per_page for the up-front reservation and the call log; here and not in configs/ocr.json, whose hash is part of every OCR cache key

The owner's decision of 2026-10-22: jev.model pinned to jev-1.14.0, the version the moving name jev-latest resolved to since 2026-10-22 05:17 UTC (its answers and cache keys are unchanged); jev.watch_alias = jev-latest, only looked at (the daily backup, jav/jev_version.py), so a newer version is reported and taken only by a decision with a measurement.
The notes and the description without the development process's references; no value changes.

265 (plan L, L2): the decisions section, OpenAI Decisions as a judgement service (jav/ai/decisions.py): its one model gpt-6-luna, its prices per token kind (uncached, read from and written to its prompt cache; above 272 000 input tokens twice), no SDK retry (as openai, 075), its prompt cache off by default (a cache write costs 1.25 times an uncached token and our requests rarely share a prefix), the shared input as an input_json part; the cache key is the translated request itself, so a change of the translation is a new question.

jev.note: Pinned to a concrete version (docs.typesafe.ai/models: versioned IDs are accepted; pin when thresholds are tuned against a version). The moving name jev-latest is only resolved by the daily look (runs/cache/_model_versions.json); jev-1.13.0 answered until 2026-10-22, its limits: docs.typesafe.ai/model-jaggedness/jev-1.13.md

retry._note: typesafe_sdk.RetryPolicy mezői; a http_statuses alapból 408/429/5xx; timeout = teljes keret egy SDK-hívásra (nagyobb, mint a timeout_s kérés-limit)

decisions.note: 265 (plan L): OpenAI's judgement service (developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/decisions, read 2026-11-01): POST /v1/decisions, gpt-6-luna its only model, no dated snapshot listed; the answer's model field goes to the ledger and the cache key. Called with the OpenAI key; its calls spend from the OpenAI budget (configs/providers.json openai_decisions).
